_comment: Work-summary Stop hook: OPTIONAL. Merge this `hooks` block into your .claude/settings.json only
if you want this project's daily work summary brought up to date automatically when a session
stops. It is a separate file from settings.hooks.example.json on purpose: wiring the
constitutional gate must never switch this on as a side effect.
What it does: on each Stop event, .claude/hooks/work-summary-stop.py checks whether today's
commits or plan files are already reflected in workSummaries/daily/<today>.md. If not, it runs
`claude --print` as @work-summarizer in the background. Each run is an ordinary Claude Code run
against your account, so the hook skips whenever nothing has changed since its last run.
No conversation is left behind: the run uses --no-session-persistence, so Claude Code saves no
session and no session list shows it. The run's full output is kept instead under
<claude config dir>/logs/agentteams-work-summary/<project>-<hash>/runs/ for 14 days
(AGENTTEAMS_WS_KEEP_DAYS; 0 keeps none). The decision log is hook.log in the same folder.
The unattended run is granted read and search tools, the Agent tool, git log/show/cat-file, ls,
and writes under workSummaries/ only, in dontAsk permission mode, with no MCP server. Deny rules
block web tools, credential files, edits under .claude/ and .github/, and the git options that
write files or read outside the repository. The grant ADDS to the allow rules in your own
settings; it does not cap them. Like every hook, the run is outside the OS sandbox, and it reads
commit messages and plan files others may have written: look at the workSummaries/ diff before
you push. The installed script is protected from agent edits by the sandbox block in
settings.hooks.example.json (denyWrite .claude, Edit(.claude/hooks/**)), once you merge that.
Check the first live run: if your summarizer needs more, set AGENTTEAMS_WS_ALLOWED_TOOLS rather
than editing the script, which --update --merge replaces. Project-specific instructions go in
extra.md in the run folder named above (your config directory, not the repository).
If a user-level Stop hook already launches a summarizer for this project, remove this project
from it BEFORE wiring this block, or both will launch. Any other harness that runs this
project's .claude/settings.json hooks will fire this hook too. A scheduler can call the script
directly: python3 .claude/hooks/work-summary-stop.py --foreground --project <project root>.
To switch it off without unwiring: AGENTTEAMS_WS_DISABLE=1. To remove it: delete the Stop entry.
